summary: Dominion Energy South Carolina filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated September 21, 2026 with BNP Paribas Securities Corp. and Scotia Capital (USA) Inc. as representatives for the sale of $300 million aggregate principal amount of 2026 Series A 6.15% First Mortgage Bonds due 2056. The bonds are registered under Rule 415 shelf and issued under the company's April 1, 1993 indenture. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation. No board recommendation or premium applies. Watch for pricing and market reception of the long-dated utility mortgage bonds.
